job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. A chubby friendly Russian guy named Sasha about 30, messy dark hair, light stubble, a wrinkled mustard-yellow hoodie, holding a smartphone in one hand. Background: a small messy rented flat in simple shapes, a pile of envelopes with bills on the table, a laptop, a houseplant. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, the character from the waist up, centred, facing the viewer, both shoulders and hands in frame, face large and clearly drawn, top of head about 22% below the upper edge (leave the top fifth calm and simple for a game HUD), looking straight at the viewer, mouth slightly open mid-sentence, a sheepish worried-but-hopeful expression. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
